strategy.overview: Devil Riders links its two moving-ramp banks to Specials and drain recovery. Complete either five-target bank to lower the moving ramp, advance Orange Special, and light REACT. Hit the flashing Advance Red Special targets to build D-E-V-I-L R-I-D-E-R-S and raise the head-wheel value; lit 20,000 targets also raise that value. Send the ball to the upper rider to collect the lit head-wheel score. Side tunnels advance the bonus multiplier. When REACT is lit, press a flipper button as the ball enters an outlane to return it to play.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete either five-target bank to lower its moving ramp, advance Orange Special, and light REACT. Hit flashing Advance Red Special targets to build Red Special and raise the head-wheel value, then send the ball to the upper rider to collect it. Use the side tunnels for Bonus X. Press a flipper button during an outlane drain while REACT is lit.
strategy.summary: Finish one five-target bank, then use its lowered moving ramp and lit awards. Build the head-wheel value from the flashing Red and 20,000 targets, collect it at the upper rider, and keep REACT ready for an outlane save.

steps.text: Complete either five-target bank to lower its moving ramp, advance Orange Special, and light REACT.
Hit flashing Advance Red Special targets to light D-E-V-I-L R-I-D-E-R-S letters and raise the head-wheel value.
Hit lit 20,000 targets to raise the head-wheel value, then send the ball to the upper rider to collect it.
Use the side tunnels to advance the bonus multiplier.

alternatives.title: Keep REACT available
alternatives.when: Use this when outlane risk matters more than finishing a Special.

steps.text: Complete the required target or bank sequence to relight REACT.
If the ball enters an outlane while REACT is lit, press the corresponding flipper button to return it to play.
Use a Spot Move Ramp target to spot a bank target and relight REACT when helpful.
Finish that bank, then take the lowered moving ramp or lit Special before beginning the other side.

machineSetup: Check the DEVIL RIDERS letters awarded per bank, Orange Special bank requirement, REACT reset setting, ball count, and configured Special awards.
Test both five-target banks, moving ramps, Spot Move Ramp targets, Advance Red and 20,000 targets, upper rider, both side tunnels, REACT lamps, and outlane switches.

cautions.issue: REACT relight and Special progress vary by setup.
cautions.response: Confirm whether one target or a whole bank relights REACT, and how many DEVIL RIDERS letters each completion awards.
